verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce's documented scope covers card enrollment, tokenization, consent/mandates, payment authorization, and dispute-evidence capture, plus a vague mention of confirming 'payment outcomes' and triggering 'post-purchase actions' (visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-5). None of the evidence describes an API or capability for an agent to query order status or shipment/delivery tracking after a purchase — that is order-fulfillment functionality typically owned by the merchant, not documented as part of this payment-rail product.
